title: 一年中的第几天
summary: 给定 YYYY-MM-DD 格式日期，返回它是该年的第几天。
insight: 累加目标月份之前各月天数，再加日期；若年份为闰年且月份晚于二月，额外加一天。
pitfalls: 能被 400 整除或能被 4 但不能被 100 整除才是闰年

solutions.title: 月份前缀与闰日
solutions.idea: 解析年月日并累计月长。
steps: 若 month>2 且年份满足闰年规则再加一，返回总数

code.java: class Solution { public int dayOfYear(String date){int year=Integer.parseInt(date.substring(0,4)),month=Integer.parseInt(date.substring(5,7)),day=Integer.parseInt(date.substring(8));int[] days={31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31};for(int i=1;i<month;i++)day+=days[i-1];if(month>2&&(year%400==0||year%4==0&&year%100!=0))day++;return day;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun dayOfYear(date:String):Int{val year=date.substring(0,4).toInt();val month=date.substring(5,7).toInt();var day=date.substring(8).toInt();val days=intArrayOf(31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31);for(i in 0 until month-1)day+=days[i];if(month>2&&(year%400==0||year%4==0&&year%100!=0))day++;return day} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int dayOfYear(string date){int year=stoi(date.substr(0,4)),month=stoi(date.substr(5,2)),day=stoi(date.substr(8));int days[]={31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31};for(int i=0;i<month-1;++i)day+=days[i];if(month>2&&(year%400==0||year%4==0&&year%100!=0))++day;return day;} };
